decision: No blocking mathematical/interface issue found in the frozen candidate. Eligible for the fixed functional experiment after parent confirms remote protocol checkpoint. No numerical result is asserted by this review.
scope: Read-only mathematical, source, protocol, input and file-identity review before this candidate is executed.

findings.coordinate_and_inputs: New fixed-z initial-state family and vector field. z0, z_rest, drive and targets are numeric constants independent of trainable theta. V1 remains unchanged; this is not an equivalent coordinate rewrite.
findings.exp_chain: torch.exp(z) is actually evaluated in FP32 and remains in the computation graph. Pre-exp finite/dtype/device validation and post-exp positive/finite checks prevent overflow/underflow from entering the financial adapter.
asset_partial_chain: Raw asset Jacobians already include dependence on the moving financial boundary; no extra shift is added.
findings.actual_rounding: The diagnostic is log(V_repr/b). log(V_repr) need not equal the original represented z; discrepancy is recorded and bounded. Gradients are continuous-formula floating AD, not classical derivatives of quantization.
findings.loss_and_dynamics: The terminal loss reads only final z and adaptation. All Euler updates use old states. Q/R are direct values, not gradients of a potential. The extra final financial readout is no-grad logging only.
findings.temporal_graph: Normal state updates remain connected. Per-time theta clones permit early contribution audit. Detach is an explicitly separate negative control. Manual A/G use full asset parameter partials and represented V times state partials.
findings.default_branch: Fixed fixtures compare represented V directly with raw b and check actual default Q=0,R=1 and zero Q/R local gradients. Original asset domain V>0 is unchanged. Original raw F/G/debt are not declared globally C1.
findings.default_trace_scope: Trajectory phase is the sign of the reported floating log(V_repr/b). The trace field true_asset_default_Q_R uses that reported margin and is not by itself a proof of exact V<=b branch classification at every representational corner. Sampled margin phase changes must be described at that scope.
findings.finite_step_scope: Finite histories must pass frozen shape/range/finiteness gates. This does not prove nonlinear stability, time-step convergence, continuous-time event times or a limit cycle. In the ideal all-default affine regime, the declared Euler A has multipliers 0.975 and 0.875; the separate A^16 check is appropriate.
findings.first_order_only: Original V3 financial backward rejects create_graph=True. Three composite readout channels are included in the new rejection checks; no Hessian or C2 force is supplied.
findings.threshold_attribution: Before/after identical physical assets can establish boundary motion and its margin shift. All nine financial parameters may also alter value-field shape, so this does not isolate a causal quality benefit of threshold movement.
findings.gate_scope: 5 fixed fixtures,15 contracts,8 temporal comparisons,16 steps by8 sequences,12 updates. Loss decrease is not a gate. Previous financial accuracy/quality gates remain unchanged.

followup: Read actual audit/training receipts, exact branch/margin separation where recorded, full trajectories, adjoints and all parameter histories. Independently recompute records without repeating the financial oracle.
